title: "download_cubes"

params:
  rank: "GENUS"
---

```{r error handling}
cat("Received rank parameter:", params$rank, "\n")
if(is.null(params$rank) || params$rank == "") {
  stop("Rank parameter is empty or not set")
}
```

```{r libraries}
library(rgbif)
library(readr)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r build query path}
rank <- params$rank

print(rank)

query <- paste0("./data/interim/cube_queries/griis_belgium_", tolower(rank), "_query.txt")

print(query)
```

```{r check query}
if(!file.exists(query)){
  stop(paste(getwd(), query, " does not exist"))
}
```

```{r read query}
query <- query %>% 
  readLines() 
```

```{r halt execution if too many active downloads}
num_active_downloads <- 3

while(num_active_downloads >= 3){
  
  # Get list of all downloads
  downloads <- occ_download_list(user = Sys.getenv("gbif_user"),
                                 pwd = Sys.getenv("gbif_pwd"))
  
  downloads <- as.data.frame(downloads)
  
  # Filter for active downloads (status is RUNNING or PREPARING)
  active_downloads <- downloads[downloads$results.status %in% c("RUNNING", "PREPARING"), ]
  
  # Get the count of active downloads
  num_active_downloads <- nrow(active_downloads)
  
  print(paste("Number of active downloads:", num_active_downloads))
  
  if(num_active_downloads >= 3){
    # downloads are staggered to avoid overloading the GBIF API
    # longest lists are triggered first to avoid long waiting times
    if(rank == "SPECIES"){
      sleep_time <- 20
    }
    
    if(rank == "SUBSPECIES_FORM_VARIETY"){
      sleep_time <- 45
    }
    
    if(rank == "GENUS"){
      sleep_time <- 70
    }
    
    if(rank == "FAMILY"){
      sleep_time <- 90
    }
    
    print(paste("Sleeping for", sleep_time, "seconds"))
    
    Sys.sleep(sleep_time)
  }
}
```

```{r download cubes}
cube <- occ_download_sql(q = query, 
                         format = "SQL_TSV_ZIP",
                         email = Sys.getenv("email"),
                         user = Sys.getenv("gbif_user"),
                         pwd = Sys.getenv("gbif_pwd"))
```

```{r create cube_data folder}
if(!dir.exists("./cube_data")){
  dir.create("./cube_data")
}
```

```{r}
occ_download_wait(cube)

occ_download_get(cube, overwrite = TRUE) %>%
  occ_download_import() %>% 
  write_csv(file = paste0("./cube_data/be_alientaxa_cube_", rank, ".csv"))
```
